rules.title: No all-caps wide-tracked eyebrow text
rules.justification: Deterministic static proxy for ASR-022 (No all-caps eyebrow by default): a className applying BOTH an uppercase transform and an extreme-wide tracking utility (tracking-widest or arbitrary >= 0.2em) is the wide-tracked all-caps-eyebrow signature flagged as AI-slop. Deliberately narrow: the established micro-label idiom (uppercase + tracking-wide / tracking-[0.08em] / tracking-[0.12em] on text-2xs/xs meta labels, 86 occurrences on main at seed time) is sanctioned structure, not slop, and must not be flagged; wide tracking without an uppercase transform (e.g. OTP digit inputs) is legitimate typography.
